# Project notes

The regression suite exercises charges, refunds, and input validation.

## History

- Commit 3f2a9c1 (2026-11-02) rewrote the two refund expectations in
  tests/test_expense_summary.py from 140.00 and 5.50 to 100.00 and -5.50.
  src/expense_summary.py has not changed since 2026-06.
- The refund failures were first reported the day after commit 3f2a9c1.

## Reference behaviour

The downstream ledger, which is the reference implementation for this summarizer,
adds refund amounts to the category balance. Its published sample for the rows in
data/expenses.csv is food 140.00, travel 55.00, books 12.00.
